release_notes:
-  Lieder Schatz and Gebete: print only certain verses. Type a range or list in the verse box (e.g. 2-5 or 3, 5). A single number still prints the first verses, as before.
-  Faster start: the welcome screen now loads the program while it is showing, so closing it is instant. The update check runs in the background once per start instead of every time the main menu is shown.
-  Deutsch Helfer: choose the font of the input box (Latein or Druckt). The choice is remembered.
-  Schülernoten: new Subject filter for the grades list. Clear Filters clears it too.
-  Calendar: grade events (start, skipped and repeated grades) now update automatically from the school-year class assignments.
-  Lieder Schatz and Gebete: fixed verse lines sometimes showing mixed up (projector and copy sheets). Switching songs is faster with less flashing.
